title: Say Subok ed Inkapgaan
intro: Sakey a komunidad, ya manpipilalek na lider ya mangidepensa ed gagala ra, so kinmerew na sakey a komandante ya ituro ed sikara. Nen naebatan so kerew da, say pinili et inawat na panduaruwa, ta sayan indibidual et agto nawalaan na minumundon kipapasen ya iilaloan da. Antis na ultimon komprontasyon, sayan balon lider so mansubok ed mismon disiplina na armada diad panamegley na simpli, balet ta aralem, a subok na panagpuger.
clues: Siak so tinuro bilang komandante kayari na saray totook ya kinmerew na lider ya milaban parad si Allah.
Dakel ed saray kabaleyan ko so inmuna ya nankuestion ed inkaturo ko, ya inkuan dan anggapoy kayamanan tan noble so kapolian ko.
Pinili ak lapud inikdan ak nen Allah na dakel a pikakabat tan mabiskeg a laman.
Say malinew a tanda na madibinon inkaturo ko et say impawil na Kaban na Sipanan ya inawit na saray angeles, ya angitarok na kareenan ed kapusoan na saray mananisia.
Legan kon onaarap a kaiba iray sondalok, inyabawag ko a nasubok kami ed abay na sakey ya ilog.
Ingganggan ko so armada ko ya siopaman ya oninum na aralem ed ilog et aliwan kabiangan ko, bangta saramay mangala labat na sakey a kutsara ed lima ra et mansiansia.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Jalut (Goliath)
Talut (Saul)
Propeta Dawud
Dhul-Qarnayn
Namrud (Nimrod)

trial.label: Antoy Manunan Subok ed Siak?
options: Manggawa na babeng sumpad Gog tan Magog
Aarapen so sakey a higante ed saksakey a laban
Panubok ed katutulok na sakey ya armada diad sakey ya ilog
Mangidaulo na armada na saray jinn tan manok
Akaliktar ed impakabantak ed apoy
trial.answer: Panubok ed katutulok na sakey ya armada diad sakey ya ilog

location.label: Antoy Manunan Tandaan na Autoridad Ko?
options: Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a kamelyo ya pinmaway ed sakey a bato
Sakey a lapis na koreo a gawad pinalemek a balatyang
Say Kaban na Sipanan (At-Tabut)
Sakey a lamisaan na kakanen a nanlapud tawen

outcome.label: Antoy Resulta na Kampanya Ko?
options: Panalo ed armada nen Jalut (Goliath)
Say pangibiig ed Ambalangan Dayat pian makaliktar ed sakey a managpairap
Say pangiletneg na andukey a dinastiya ed ngaran ko
Say pangipaalagey na sagradon Kaaba ed Makkah
Say iyatagey ed tawen ya ag-ompatey

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
